chapter2.title: AMM: main areas of work
chapter2.p1:
What can AMM offer?
Most often, they fulfill orders for:
list: Creating 3D products that make complex things easier to understand and more accessible.
Improving and boosting sales, communication with B2B clients, and investors.
Visualizing processes and products that are difficult to show using traditional methods.
chapter2.p2:
AMM is confident that effective visualization not only makes it easier to understand a particular product, but also contributes to faster and more confident decision-making regarding orders or investments.

Let's take a closer look at each of these offerings.

chapter3.title: Visualization of complex technologies in 3D
chapter3.p1:
One of the key areas of AMM's work is the creation or development of 3D products.
The goal of such projects is to demonstrate technologies that are impossible or difficult to show using traditional, more familiar methods.
chapter3.p2:
For example, by visualizing batteries, engines, filters, and other technical systems, it is possible to reveal the principles of their operation to interested parties and make everything more understandable even for people without special technological knowledge.

An excellent example of this is the interactive Multiboard Lite Plus. When creating the device, the developers combined a wide range of the best technologies with the properties of a traditional board. This model is suitable for use in education and business. It is convenient for creating presentations, conducting online meetings, learning, and working.

chapter4.title: Visualization of complex systems and processes
chapter4.p1: The processes involved in working with engineering systems and the sequence of decommissioning complex equipment are very difficult to understand. All this involves the interaction of numerous systems and components that have specific features of operation under extreme conditions and differ in a multitude of specific functions.
chapter4.p2:
Interesting projects also allow you to "visualize" in detail the features of integration and interaction of various components, and familiarize yourself in advance with possible problems in unpredictable conditions.

Impeccable detail allows both customers and partners to evaluate the optimality, reliability, and functionality of the equipment.

chapter6.title: Improving communications and sales
chapter6.p1:
Visualization of technological solutions of varying complexity greatly helps to boost sales and improve communication with investors and B2B customers.

This approach significantly reduces the time needed to convey information and ensures a clear understanding of the product's features, its benefits, and its potential for integration into specific operations or processes.
chapter6.p2: AMM's 3D models and animations help convey even the most complex concepts to the audience, presenting them clearly and accessibly in practice. Of course, this increases the likelihood of a successful deal, as both customers and investors understand the real results of using a particular product, rather than simply studying abstract and incomprehensible technical characteristics.

chapter7.title: Durability and ease of maintenance
chapter7.p1:
AMM focuses on creating products that are easy to use, understand, and maintain.
AMM is very interested in durability.
chapter7.p2: And through visualization, customers can explain how the equipment works, what advantages or problems are possible, and how to ensure proper operation and maintenance over time.
